business_problem: Swiss Post needed to replace rigid legacy middleware and hundreds of point-to-point interfaces that were limiting operational agility, raising cost, and slowing parcel, routing, and partner processes across a nationwide logistics network.
solution_summary: Swiss Post executed an integration overhaul around an event-driven architecture centered on Apache Kafka, Confluent, and modern API management. More than a simple middleware replacement, the program refactored over 60 applications and 350 interfaces into a self-service integration fabric for parcel tracking, route optimization, partner communication, and other logistics flows. Confluent provides the core streaming backbone, while automation, onboarding tooling, topic classification, quality gates, and access workflows bake governance into every data flow. The platform also exposes observability through dashboards and searchable interfaces so business and IT users can understand and reuse streams instead of treating them as black boxes. This foundation supports secure partner integrations, direct Kafka-to-Kafka exchanges, and next-generation telemetry workloads, while giving Swiss Post the operational flexibility and organizational agility it could not achieve with its legacy stack.

solution_components.name: Confluent
solution_components.role: Provides Swiss Post's managed streaming backbone for logistics integrations and governed self-service access.

solution_components.name: Apache Kafka
solution_components.role: Carries real-time events across parcel, route, partner, and telemetry workflows in the new architecture.

data_flow: Operational data from parcel systems, routing processes, and partner interfaces streams through Kafka and Confluent, where governed topics, automated controls, and observability tooling expose the events for internal teams and external partners in real time.
business_outcome: Swiss Post increased integration scale tenfold while keeping reliability high, reduced hardware and software costs, and gave logistics teams a governed real-time backbone for faster service innovation and partner collaboration.
metrics: two minor incidents in five years
architecture_clues: Every Kafka topic is governed with mandatory classification, quality gates, and access approval workflows.
Swiss Post uses cross-site, multilingual teams plus transparent dashboards and an internal wiki to operationalize the platform.
The organization is preparing larger telemetry workloads and bi-directional Kafka-to-Kafka partner integrations on the same backbone.

"Swiss Post needed to seamlessly transition over 60 applications and 350 interfaces."
"Every Kafka topic was governed with mandatory classification, automated quality gates, and access approval workflows."
